Note.title: Note
Note.description: A user's personal note supporting rich text, checklists, voice transcripts, reminders, color tints, and PIN lock protection.

id.description: Unique identifier matching the document ID.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated note owner.

title.description: Headline title of the note (0 to 300 chars).

content.description: Main body text of the note (0 to 50000 chars).

folderId.description: Associated folder ID or empty string for unfiled.

tags.description: Bounded list of up to 10 string tags.

checklistItems.description: Bounded list of up to 50 checklist item strings formatted with [x] or [ ] prefix.

isPinned.description: Whether the note is pinned to the top of the list.

isTrashed.description: Whether the note is in the trash.

isLocked.description: Whether the note is protected by the user's privacy lock.

colorKey.description: Editorial surface tint key for the note card.

voiceDurationSec.description: Duration of the captured voice memo in seconds.

reminderAtMillis.description: Scheduled reminder epoch milliseconds, or 0 if unset.

wordCount.description: Computed word count for quick reading-time estimation.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the note was created (must use FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the note was last modified (must use FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

Folder.title: Folder
Folder.description: A user-defined collection folder for organizing notes.

id.description: Unique identifier matching the folder document ID.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated folder owner.

name.description: Display name of the folder (1 to 80 chars).

accentKey.description: Accent color identifier for the folder.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the folder was created (must use FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the folder was last updated (must use FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/notes/{noteId}.description: Per-user notes collection isolated by userId.

/users/{userId}/folders/{folderId}.description: Per-user folders collection isolated by userId.
